run_flux_prior_redux_pipeline: run the FluxPriorReduxPipeline to encode an image into prompt and pooled prompt embeddings
encode_image_with_siglip: encode an input image using the SiglipVisionModel image encoder and feature extractor
encode_text_prompt_embeds: encode text prompts into T5 and CLIP prompt embeddings with optional LoRA scaling
validate_pipeline_inputs: validate pipeline inputs including image, prompt, prompt_embeds, and scaling parameters
concatenate_and_scale_embeddings: concatenate image and text embeddings, apply scaling factors, and produce weighted sum embeddings
